name: performance-pack
title: Performance Pack
author: bespoked
description:
Quieter, cooler X/Y motion and a purge line that is out of your way, in one install. TMC Auto-Tuned applies Argolein's optimized TMC2240 driver settings to the X and Y steppers, TMC Low Current drops their run current from 1.2 to 1.0 A for less heat and less noise, and Purge Line at Back moves the start-of-print purge line from the front of the plate to the back, clear of the part. The two driver changes touch different settings, so they work together.

These are low-level driver changes: watch the motor temperatures on the first print, and if you see a layer shift on a fast or heavy move, remove TMC Low Current and the stock current comes back. Snapmaker U1 only.
tagline: Quieter, cooler X/Y motion and a purge line out of your way.
